pages.title: CEEW heat risk study — Andhra Pradesh tops

facts.text: Study: CEEW (Council on Energy, Environment and Water) — "How Extreme Heat is Impacting India: Assessing District-level Heat Risk"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Rank 1: ⚠ Andhra Pradesh — most heat-risk-prone state
facts.head: News

facts.text: 100% districts high/very high risk: AP, Kerala, Maharashtra, Goa
facts.head: News

facts.text: AP districts: 62% high risk, 38% very high risk
facts.head: News

facts.text: India: 57% of districts high/very high risk — home to 76% of population
facts.head: News

facts.text: Nights warming faster: 70% of AP districts have at least 5 extra 'very warm' nights per summer (March–June)
facts.head: Trends

facts.text: Diurnal Temperature Range (DTR) has decreased — linked to higher mortality, malaria/dengue
facts.head: Trends

facts.text: Urban heat islands: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Tirupati, Guntur
facts.head: Trends

facts.text: J&K and Ladakh: 15+ more very hot days and warm nights per summer
facts.head: Trends

facts.text: Source: Civil Registration System (CRS) report for 2021
facts.head: News

facts.text: Reason for deaths spike: COVID-19 second wave
facts.head: News

facts.text: Infant deaths: rural 613→686; urban 4,634→6,855 — urban over 90% of rise
facts.head: News

facts.text: Measure: Highest births; Districts: Kurnool (88,914), East Godavari (74,765), Guntur (67,565)
facts.head: Districts

facts.text: Measure: Lowest births; Districts: Vizianagaram (32,023), Srikakulam (36,290)
facts.head: Districts

facts.text: Measure: Highest deaths; Districts: East Godavari (67,406), Guntur (63,872), Krishna (56,317)
facts.head: Districts

facts.text: Measure: Lowest deaths; Districts: Vizianagaram (23,657), Srikakulam (28,034)
facts.head: Districts
